conviction_note: The print carries a scheduled binary the hunt cannot resolve: Quadient said on 20 July it would update on the strategic review of its Lockers business 'in conjunction with its first-half 2026 results on 23 September 2026', with Rothschild & Co, Societe Generale and Darrois Villey appointed. So the reaction is dominated by an announcement whose direction is not researchable from outside, and the honest expected value is small with a very wide band. What the tape does say is that the market has stopped paying for the review: +6.0% on 96k shares the day it was announced, and the stock is back at EUR 12.52 against EUR 12.00 the session before. The sum of the findings is +0.9 and the band is roughly -9 to +9 -- this name fell 17.8% on its last H1 print and 15% on its last FY print.
bar: FY 2026 guidance of -2% to +2% organic revenue change, confirmed at Q1 on 21 May 2026; analyst consensus 12-month target EUR 19.40-20.30 against a EUR 12.52 spot. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/21/3299560/0/en/QUADIENT-SA-Q1-2026-revenue-Strong-bookings-and-usage-growth-accelerating-Digital-platform-adoption-FY-2026-guidance-confirmed.html
session_check: amc, confirmed against the issuer's own financial calendar: half-year results and Q2 2026 sales on 23 September 2026 AFTER market close, with a quiet period from 9 to 23 September. https://rss.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/01/19/3221174/0/en/QUADIENT-SA-2026-FINANCIAL-CALENDAR.html . Baseline said amc on vendor flag 1; the two agree.
positioning_check: The AMF register read for this run (as of 2026-09-16) and does NOT name Quadient, so its disclosed net short is 0.0 at the 0.5% threshold -- a real zero at that threshold, not a measurement: `anchor_covered` is false on this baseline and there is no positioning anchor. What the register does not carry, and the AMF's threshold-crossing file does: Janus Henderson Investors UK Limited crossed ABOVE 5% of capital and voting rights on 23 July 2026 and holds 1,741,870 shares, 5.05%. AMF declaration 226C1172 of 30 July 2026.

findings.finding: The market has given back most of what it paid for the Lockers strategic review. Quadient rose +6.00% on 96,222 shares on 20 July, roughly three times its recent volume, the day it announced the review; it closed at EUR 12.52 on 16 September against EUR 12.00 on 17 July. So the review premium has decayed to about a third of the announcement move over two months, into a print that is scheduled to carry the review's outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is not a line the company reports; it is the setup. The two most recent prints both fell hard on guidance rather than on strategy -- -17.8% on the H1 2025 print of 25 September 2025 when FY guidance was cut on softer US mail, and about -15% on the FY 2025 print in March 2026.
findings.original_quote: Quadient expects to provide an update on the strategic review in conjunction with its first-half 2026 results on 23 September 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: The fact that a review was announced is priced -- it moved the stock 6% on the day. What is not visible in any note is that the premium has bled away: the closing prices are public but nobody publishes the decay. If the market were positioned for a value-realising outcome on a EUR 432m market cap with a business doing EUR 114m of revenue and an EBITDA margin expected above 10%, the stock would not be trading below where it opened the day after the announcement.
findings.independence: The price path is computed from the daily closes on https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/QDT.PA?range=6mo&interval=1d (20 July 12.72 on 96,222 shares against 17 July 12.00 on 22,793; 16 September 12.52 on 38,390). Independent of the review release itself.

findings.finding: Janus Henderson Investors UK Limited crossed above the 5% threshold of Quadient's capital and voting rights on 23 July 2026 -- three days after the Lockers review was announced -- and holds 1,741,870 shares, 5.05%, bought on the market on behalf of funds and clients it manages.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No directly comparable prior event for this name. Treated as a small positive because a 5% holder that built the position after the review was announced is a marginal buyer that is unlikely to sell into an ambiguous update, on a name where the disclosed short register is empty.

Ce franchissement de seuils resulte d'une acquisition d'actions QUADIENT S.A. sur le marche. [translation: Janus Henderson Investors UK Limited declared it crossed above the 5% threshold of Quadient's capital and voting rights on 23 July 2026 and holds 1,741,870 shares, 5.05%, acquired on the market.]
findings.why_not_priced: It is a PDF on the AMF's regulated-information flux (declaration 226C1172) and no press account of it was found in either language. The short register, which is what this stage's baseline reads, does not carry long positions at all, so the only visible positioning signal on this name says 'nothing disclosed'.
findings.independence: none found -- the AMF declaration is the only source located for it, which is part of why it is sized small.

findings.finding: The one unambiguously good line at this print has already been released. On 24 August Quadient disclosed Q2 Digital bookings up more than 20% year on year like-for-like, with French bookings up more than tenfold including a multi-million-euro white-label deal, ahead of France's e-invoicing mandate; on 1 September it followed with a release on serving over 800,000 entities in the mandate's first phase. The stock paid for it -- +3.26%, +1.58%, +1.86% over the three sessions from 24 August -- and has since given that back too.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Quadient's last two prints were both decided by Mail and by guidance, not by Digital: the September 2025 fall was attributed to a softer US mail rebound and hardware placements down 17.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: This one IS priced -- that is the finding. It is signed negative because it removes the line most likely to beat from the information the print still carries, leaving Mail, the FY guidance and the review update, which are the three things that have gone against this stock in the last two prints.
findings.independence: The three-session price reaction is from the same daily-close series as finding 1; the 1 September French e-invoicing release is a separate filing on the AMF flux (Quadient, 2026-09-01, Inside Information).

outside_window.finding: Q3 2026 sales are scheduled for 1 December 2026, and any Lockers transaction announced on 23 September would not complete inside this stage's one-session window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Named bidders or a leaked process for the Lockers business: nothing in English or French wire coverage between 20 July and 19 September.

Any broker action inside the 9-23 September quiet period: the most recent located is Oddo BHF reiterating outperform with a target cut from EUR 25 to EUR 23, undated in the snippet and therefore not used as evidence.
Boursier.com, Zonebourse, Les Echos and Investir: all refuse this container, as LESSONS.md records.

The AMF flux's own PDFs cannot be read by WebFetch and the container has no working pdftotext/pdfminer/pypdf (the cryptography module is broken); they were read with a stdlib zlib-based extractor written for this run.
baseline_tension: Neutral to mildly with the lean: the baseline's priced_lean_pct is -0.09, which is the 20-day run-up alone because Quadient carries no disclosed short, so there is no positioning anchor to agree or disagree with; my +0.9 is not beating a lean, it is beating nothing.
local_pass_note: The English pass found the strategic review, the Digital pre-release and the two prior double-digit falls, and produced one finding: the pre-release removes the print's best line (-0.8).

The local pass, run over the AMF's own regulated-information flux (info-financiere.gouv.fr) and the French press, added both of the other findings. The Janus Henderson 5.05% crossing exists only as a French-language AMF PDF and was not found in any press account.
The local pass also supplied the consensus picture (target EUR 19.40-20.30 against EUR 12.52) and Decision Bourse's 25 August buy note, neither of which became a finding.
lessons_applied: NOT A CLEAN FREEZE, and this must not be pooled. This hunt was run by the orchestrating session rather than by an isolated `unpriced-hunter-fr` subagent, because this session cannot spawn subagents, and it had read researcher_europe/LESSONS.md before the hunt began. pre_lessons is therefore equal to the emitted set by construction and is not a measurement of what the file changed.

The rules that did bear on the work: the session was confirmed against the issuer's own calendar rather than the vendor's flag; the date was read out of the source for every dated fact; and the caveat reaches the number -- the sum is +0.9 on a name whose last two prints moved -17.8% and -15%, which is why the band is wide rather than the point estimate large.
